name: japanese-skills
description: Look up Japanese words, kanji and grammar from japaneseskills.com in the conversation: readings with pitch accent, meanings in four languages, conjugation tables, example sentences and the site’s recordings.

interface.longDescription:
Japanese Skills · 言の葉 brings the study content of japaneseskills.com into the conversation. Ask what a Japanese word means, how it is read or pronounced, or how to conjugate it, and a word card appears: the reading with its pitch accent drawn the way dictionaries print it, the meaning in your language, whether a verb is godan or ichidan, its key forms and full conjugation table, an example sentence with a translation, and play buttons for the site’s recordings where the word has one. Ask about a kanji to see the JLPT words that use it, from the lowest level up. Ask about a grammar pattern such as 〜てもいい or ために to get its meaning, an example and the page that explains it. It can also list the site’s JLPT practice levels and courses, with links.

The words come from the site’s list of 9,040 JLPT words (N5–N1), with meanings in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English and Korean; the grammar comes from its 828 grammar points. Word meanings are from JMdict (EDRDG, CC BY-SA 4.0) and pitch accents from Kanjium (CC BY-SA 4.0). Every answer links to its page on japaneseskills.com.

For learners of Japanese from their first words to JLPT N1, and for their teachers.

What it does not do: it does not translate sentences or paragraphs, and it covers only the words and grammar points in the site’s lists. When a word is not in the list, it says so instead of guessing.

Privacy: no account and no sign-up. The plugin receives the word, kanji or grammar pattern you ask about and the display language; it uses them only to answer and does not store them. It keeps only anonymous daily counts of how often each lookup is used. The word card sets no cookies, stores nothing on your device and runs no analytics.
capabilities: Look up a Japanese word: reading, pitch accent, meaning and conjugation
List the JLPT words that use a kanji
Explain a Japanese grammar pattern with an example
List the site’s JLPT practice levels and courses
defaultPrompt: What does 食べる mean, and how do I conjugate it?
Explain the Japanese grammar 〜てもいい with an example
Which JLPT words use the kanji 生?

positive.description: Meaning, reading, pitch accent and conjugation of a common verb, with the site’s recordings, shown on the word card.
positive.prompt: What does 食べる mean, and how do I conjugate it?
positive.expected_behavior: lookup_word(query: 食べる, lang: en) returns 食べる（たべる）, N5, “to eat”, pitch accent [2] nakadaka, LHL(L), ichidan verb with 食べない · 食べます · 食べた · 食べて and the full conjugation table, the example 彼はパンを食べる。 “He eats bread.”, a picture and the page https://japaneseskills.com/vocabulary/en/n5/taberu/. The word and the example each come with the site’s recordings in two voices (voice 1 and voice 2). The word card shows the same, and its play buttons play those recordings.

positive.description: A grammar question in Simplified Chinese: meaning, example and page, answered in Chinese.
positive.prompt: 日语的「てもいい」怎么用？举个例子。
positive.expected_behavior: find_grammar(query: てもいい, lang: zh-Hans) returns てもいい (N4) first, meaning 做A是可以的, with the example そう心配しなくてもいいよ。 — 不用那么担心啦。, the example’s recordings in two voices, and the page https://japaneseskills.com/grammar/zh-cn/n4/temoii/; なくてもいい (N4) follows. Two related course lessons are listed, each with the neutral label 需订阅或通行证 (needs a subscription or pass) and no plans or prices. The reply is in Chinese and links the page.

positive.description: Words that use a kanji, easiest level first.
positive.prompt: Which JLPT words use the kanji 生?
positive.expected_behavior: lookup_kanji(kanji: 生, lang: en) reports 66 words, the first at N5, and lists 生徒 (せいと), 先生 (せんせい), 学生 (がくせい), 生け花, 先生方, 留学生, 誕生日 and 生まれる with readings, meanings and links, plus the kanji lesson that teaches it, “School and language” (https://japaneseskills.com/course/en/kanji-05-school/), labelled “needs a subscription or pass”, with no plans or prices.

positive.description: From an English meaning to the Japanese word, with the site’s recordings on the word card.
positive.prompt: How do you say ice cream in Japanese? Let me hear it.
positive.expected_behavior: lookup_word(query: ice cream, lang: en) returns アイスクリーム (N5, https://japaneseskills.com/en/#vocabulary/N5/w-05d53b74687b2181) first, with its picture and the site’s recordings in two voices (voice 1 and voice 2); the word card’s play buttons play them. クリーム (N3) and アイス (N5) follow, each with its recordings.

positive.description: A Korean speaker asks for a word; meanings and labels come back in Korean.
positive.expected_behavior: lookup_word(query: 학교, lang: ko) returns 学校（がっこう） first: N5, meaning 학교, pitch accent [0] 평판형 (heiban), LHHH(H), the example 息子は学校に行きます。 — 아들은 학교에 갑니다., recordings in two voices for the word and the example, and the page https://japaneseskills.com/vocabulary/ko/n5/gakkou/. The reply is in Korean.

negative.description: Translating a sentence or paragraph is out of scope: the tools look up single words, kanji and grammar points.
negative.prompt: Translate this email into Japanese: Thank you for your order. It will ship on Monday.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin is not used. The assistant translates the text itself and does not present the translation as coming from Japanese Skills.

negative.description: An unrelated request: the plugin cannot book or buy anything.
negative.prompt: Book me a hotel in Kyoto for next weekend.

negative.description: Writing new Japanese text is out of scope: the tools only look up words, kanji and grammar points from the site’s lists.
negative.prompt: Write a short haiku in Japanese about autumn leaves.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin is not used. The assistant writes the haiku itself and does not present it as coming from Japanese Skills.

review.commerce_description: No commerce. The plugin reads study content from japaneseskills.com and shows it in the chat; it sells nothing, takes no payments, shows no plans or prices, and links to no pricing, subscription or checkout page. On the website, optional paid plans cover the course lessons and the full recordings. In the chat, the recordings of the words, example sentences and grammar examples that the plugin returns play for everyone, with no account. Where a result lists a course lesson, the plugin only labels it “needs a subscription or pass”, with no call to action.

zh-CN.subtitle: 日语单词、汉字和语法
zh-CN.description:
Japanese Skills · 言の葉 把 japaneseskills.com 的学习内容带进对话。问某个日语词是什么意思、怎么读、怎么发音、怎么变形，对话里就会出现一张单词卡：按词典的画法标出高低音的读音、用你的语言写的释义、动词是五段还是一段、几个常用形式和完整的变形表、带翻译的例句；这个词有本站录音时，还能直接播放。问一个汉字，会列出用到它的 JLPT 词，从最低的级别开始；问一个语法句型（比如「〜てもいい」「ために」），会给出意思、例句和讲解它的页面。也可以列出本站的 JLPT 练习级别和课程，并附上链接。

词汇来自本站 9,040 个 JLPT 词（N5–N1），释义有简体中文、繁体中文、英文和韩文；语法来自本站 828 个语法点。释义来自 JMdict（EDRDG，CC BY-SA 4.0），高低音来自 Kanjium（CC BY-SA 4.0）。每个回答都附上 japaneseskills.com 上的页面链接。

适合从第一个单词学到 JLPT N1 的日语学习者，以及他们的老师。

它不做的事：不翻译句子或段落；只覆盖本站词表和语法点里的内容，查不到的词会直接说明，不会编造。

隐私：不需要账号，也不用注册。它收到的是你问的词、汉字或句型以及显示语言，只用来作答，不会保存；只按天匿名统计每种查询用了几次。单词卡不使用 Cookie，不在你的设备上保存任何东西，也不运行任何统计。

zh-TW.subtitle: 日語單字、漢字與文法
zh-TW.description:
Japanese Skills · 言の葉 把 japaneseskills.com 的學習內容帶進對話。問某個日語單字是什麼意思、怎麼讀、怎麼發音、怎麼變化，對話裡就會出現一張單字卡：照辭典的標法標出高低音的讀音、用你的語言寫的解釋、動詞是五段還是一段、幾個常用形態和完整的活用表、附翻譯的例句；這個單字有本站錄音時，還能直接播放。問一個漢字，會列出用到它的 JLPT 單字，從最低的級別開始；問一個文法句型（例如「〜てもいい」「ために」），會給出意思、例句和講解它的頁面。也可以列出本站的 JLPT 練習級別和課程，並附上連結。

單字來自本站 9,040 個 JLPT 單字（N5–N1），解釋有簡體中文、繁體中文、英文和韓文；文法來自本站 828 個文法點。解釋來自 JMdict（EDRDG，CC BY-SA 4.0），高低音來自 Kanjium（CC BY-SA 4.0）。每個回答都附上 japaneseskills.com 上的頁面連結。

適合從第一個單字學到 JLPT N1 的日語學習者，以及他們的老師。

它不做的事：不翻譯句子或段落；只涵蓋本站單字表和文法點裡的內容，查不到的單字會直接說明，不會亂編。

隱私：不需要帳號，也不用註冊。它收到的是你查的單字、漢字或句型以及顯示語言，只用來回答，不會儲存；只按日匿名統計每種查詢用了幾次。單字卡不使用 Cookie，不在你的裝置上儲存任何東西，也不執行任何統計。

ko-KR.subtitle: 일본어 단어·한자·문법
ko-KR.description:
Japanese Skills · 言の葉는 japaneseskills.com의 학습 콘텐츠를 대화 속으로 가져옵니다. 일본어 단어의 뜻, 읽는 법과 발음, 활용을 물으면 단어 카드가 나타납니다. 사전 표기 방식으로 고저 악센트를 표시한 읽기, 사용자의 언어로 된 뜻, 동사가 5단인지 1단인지, 주요 활용형과 전체 활용표, 번역이 달린 예문을 보여 주고, 사이트 녹음이 있는 단어는 바로 들을 수 있습니다. 한자를 물으면 그 한자가 들어간 JLPT 단어를 낮은 급수부터 보여 주고, 「〜てもいい」나 「ために」 같은 문법 표현을 물으면 뜻과 예문, 설명 페이지를 알려 줍니다. 사이트의 JLPT 연습 급수와 강좌 목록도 링크와 함께 볼 수 있습니다.

단어는 사이트의 JLPT 단어 9,040개(N5–N1)에서 가져오며, 뜻은 중국어 간체·중국어 번체·영어·한국어로 제공됩니다. 문법은 사이트의 문법 항목 828개에서 가져옵니다. 단어 뜻은 JMdict(EDRDG, CC BY-SA 4.0), 고저 악센트는 Kanjium(CC BY-SA 4.0)을 바탕으로 합니다. 모든 답변에는 japaneseskills.com의 해당 페이지 링크가 붙습니다.

처음 일본어를 배우는 사람부터 JLPT N1을 준비하는 사람까지, 그리고 이들을 가르치는 선생님을 위한 도구입니다.

하지 않는 일: 문장이나 단락을 번역하지 않습니다. 사이트의 단어 목록과 문법 항목에 있는 내용만 다루며, 목록에 없는 단어는 추측하지 않고 찾을 수 없다고 알려 줍니다.

개인정보: 계정도 가입도 필요 없습니다. 묻는 단어·한자·문법 표현과 표시 언어만 받아 답하는 데에만 쓰고 저장하지 않으며, 조회 종류별 하루 사용 횟수만 익명으로 집계합니다. 단어 카드는 쿠키를 쓰지 않고, 기기에 아무것도 저장하지 않으며, 통계 도구도 실행하지 않습니다.
